textures.operation: linear non-color downsample; normalize tangent RGB vectors; lossless PNG

sole_measurement.method: Actual evaluated mesh vertices in the lowest 25mm rest band, split by rest X sign; 121 finite poses. This is not a foot IK or contact solver.

limitations: 121 finite idle samples are not continuous deformation approval
REST height/floor is separate from actual animated sole heights/drift
No AAA, hardware, performance or actual-game visual approval
